name: Algator Speedrun
storyline:
Algator has entered a mysterious vertical challenge where there is only one way to go: up.

Starting from the ground, Algator must jump from platform to platform and climb higher and higher. But the platforms never stay in the same place for long. As the world scrolls upward, new platforms appear while the ones below disappear into the distance.

There is no finish line and no safe place to stop. The only way to prove your worth is to keep climbing and survive for as long as possible.

Every jump increases the score. Every platform brings Algator closer to the top. But one missed jump is enough to end the run.

When the challenge is over, your score is added to the leaderboard. Only the best players will remain among the top five.

How high can Algator climb?

The challenge has begun. Jump, climb, survive… and beat the score.
summary:
Algator Speedrun is a fast-paced vertical platformer where the goal is simple: climb as high as possible without falling.

Control Algator from platform to platform using the left and right directions. Each successful jump helps you climb higher while new platforms continuously appear above you. As you progress, your score increases, turning every run into a challenge to beat your previous record.

Once you fall, the run is over. Enter your name and see if your score can make it into the top 5 of the local leaderboard.

Featuring a colorful arcade-style interface, custom Algator references, Minecraft-inspired splash texts, sound effects and a constantly changing platform layout, Algator Speedrun is all about reflexes, precision and chasing the highest score.
